diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate upward trend (a net rise of ~37% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (4 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.084), which favours a robust combination.
